notes.pest_disease: Flea beetle damage is the primary concern for arugula, creating small holes in leaves. Floating row covers are the most effective prevention method.
notes.harvest_marker: Harvest at 4-5 inches for baby leaf market. Leaves should be dark green and peppery. Cut above the growing point for regrowth.
notes.storage_handling: Cool immediately after harvest. Store at 2-4 degrees C. Arugula has a short post-harvest life of 5-7 days even under ideal conditions.
notes.cultivar_recommendation: Runway variety offers good bolt resistance and yield. For year-round production in protected environments, choose slower-bolting types.
notes.growing_tip: Arugula is one of the easiest crops to direct seed. Broadcast seeding works well for baby leaf production at high density.
notes.irrigation: Even moisture is critical; drought stress causes premature bolting. Irrigation at early morning reduces disease pressure.
